{{Quote|Tarnis will use the Planet Prison against Coruscant. He could trap us here forever. Paralyze the Republic by holding us hostage. You're our only hope of stopping that.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] embarked on a '''mission''' to the heart of [[Justicar territory]], home of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] goal was to retrieve the [[Planet Prison]], a Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that had been stolen by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on the [[Republic superweapon initiative|project]] at the behest of their leader, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]. However, the scientists were unaware that Tarnis was, in fact, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].

The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] the research team and stolen the Planet Prison by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] and Carsen reached the [[Justicars' Tower]], where they had traced an earlier transmission by Tarnis. The only surviving member of the team, a fatally wounded [[Human/Legends|man]] named [[Jonkan]], helped the two Jedi locate the Planet Prison in the depths of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The Jedi subsequently pursued Tarnis and defeated him in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] before deactivating the weapon and thwarting the Sith's plan to use it against the Republic capital.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I just traced that holocall we intercepted from the Black Sun base. Tarnis was communicating from down in sector 439.''"<br />"''Justicar territory! Tarnis knows we're not welcome there.|Carsen, and Suthra|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] became aware that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], the lead [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] on the Republic's [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] project, was, in fact, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Tarnis's cover was exposed when he arranged for the [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|theft]] of files on the [[Republic superweapon initiative]]<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> and allied himself with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. Tarnis contacted his research team, the members of whom were unaware of his true identity, and urged them to bring him the Planet Prison prototype, as he claimed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were planning to shut down the project. Believing Tarnis, the five scientists secured the prototype and took it to Tarnis deep in [[Justicar territory]], the territory of the paramilitary<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> and Imperial-friendly [[Justicars' Brigade]].<ref name="A Diverting Assignment">{{TORcite|type=general|A Diverting Assignment|Coruscant}}</ref>

A [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] had launched a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|rescue mission]] in the [[Black Sun territory|territory]] of Black Sun after Tarnis had arranged for Black Sun to stage his [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]],<ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref> but instead of finding the scientist, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] learned of Tarnis's duplicity and his true identity as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="The Rescue" /> Returning to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] Building, the Knight was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to pursue Tarnis and the stolen Planet Prison to the Justicars' Sector, where the origin of Tarnis's transmission to the Knight had been traced. The Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] accompanied the Knight in case the pair encountered the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] in their search, and the two set off for the Justicars' Sector.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Tarnis tricked us. Said you Jedi were going to shut the project down. Told us to bring the Planet Prison here. Keep it safe. Thought we were saving the Republic. We brought Tarnis the prototype. He turned on us. Killed everyone.|Jonkan|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
[[File:Jonkan_dying.png|thumb|right|200px|With his dying breath, Jonkan aided the Knight in locating the Planet Prison.]]
As the two Jedi took an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] to the Justicars' Sector, Tarnis met with his research team in the [[Justicars' Tower]], the Brigade's [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and interrogation center. Once he had obtained possession of the Planet Prison, Tarnis turned on them, revealing himself to be a Sith and then [[Death/Legends|murdering them]] with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. However, one of the scientists, a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Jonkan]], was only gravely injured, and he watched as Tarnis departed with the Planet Prison prototype.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

The Knight and Carsen were forced to fight their way through hostile Justicars to reach their destination, but by the [[Time/Legends|time]] they arrived, Tarnis had already left the area, and the two Jedi found only the bodies of the research team and a dying Jonkan. Knowing he was severely wounded, Jonkan shrugged off the Jedi's reassurances that they would get help and quickly explained what had happened. In his final moments, Jonkan explained how the Knight and Carsen could track the Planet Prison: The device generated enormous amounts of heat and required time to charge to full capacity, giving them time to find and destroy the weapon before it could fire. Urging the Knight to save Coruscant, Jonkan gasped his final breath and passed away.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Running a thermal scan&hellip; whoa, the technician wasn't kidding. Something's really lighting up. Tracking&hellip; Here we go. Sector 167, coordinates 8863&hellip; Oh, you've got to be kidding me. The signal's coming from the ruins of the Jedi Temple.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
Using Jonkan's information, Carsen tracked the location of the Planet Prison using the room's [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. Tarnis had taken the weapon to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as a final insult to the Jedi.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> With no time to spare, the two Jedi raced through [[The Works/Legends|the Works]], Coruscant's industrial and infrastructure district, toward the Temple and their final confrontation with Tarnis. The pair located Tarnis in the ruins of the Temple and [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|defeated]] him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], though Tarnis's death incurred the wrath of his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to the Justicar's Sector was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears in the Jedi Knight-class story mission "Tracking Down the Traitor," in which the player pursues the Sith Lord Tarnis to the Justicars' Sector in an attempt to find the Planet Prison superweapon. While the mission does not feature any alignment choices, it is notable for being the first mission in which the player receives Kira Carsen as a companion. She serves as a guest companion for this and the next mission, which means that she cannot be sent on crew skill missions.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />
